scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Proceeded to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, and the Lisbon address at 12 Rua Augusta.
Placed the order successfully; the confirmation stated that the order is in and €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason: The clicked Paper Filters plus control left quantity, shipping, and total unchanged after waiting.
scenarios.diagnosis: The Paper Filters increase control did not apply the requested quantity change, leaving the bag below the free-shipping threshold.
scenarios.suggestion: Fix the Paper Filters + control so one press raises its quantity from 1 to 2 and recalculates the order to Free shipping and €51.00.

scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.

The discount was −€9.10, shipping was Free, and the final total was €81.90.
